hymns.searchText: kude kangakanani ekhaya? 5 ekhaya ku sekude na? ngi buzil’ umlindi yena. wath’ ub’ suku: bu yaphela, manje seku yasa. ngakho: u ngabusakhala, kodwa, hamba u phalale; u zofik’ ezinsukwini, ezingasapheli! se ngi buzile ibutho, ingoma yebutho ithi: ngesibindi ngi zokulwa, ngay’inkemba yodwa ngakho: u ngabusakhala, empini bekezela- umvuz’ u phiw’ ophumile, nxa esenqobile. ngi buzile into zonke, zi sho ngazwi linye zonke; isikhathi si yaphela, ikhaya li vele. ngakho: u ngabusakhala, iziboniso zi yanda konkana ku yabubula, ku fun’ inkululo. ekhaya a kusekude, yeka! umkhumbulo omhle; thokoza ke wena mhambi, sul’ izinyembezi. ngakho: u ngabusukhala; si zohlangana phambili, izinhlupho zi phelile: emzin’ othulile.

hymns.searchText: vuka, moya wami vuka! 243 vuka moya vuka! thintit’ ukwesala. umhlatshel’ ob’hlungu, uvezelwe mina. es’hlalwen’ ujes’ ung’mele; es’hlalwen’ ujes’ ung’mele; ngilotshiw’ esandlen’ sakhe. uhlel’ ezulwini, ukunginxusela. ngothand’ ol’hlengayo, negaz’ el’ncengayo. igazi lakhe las’thenga; igazi lakhe las’thenga; lifafaz’ is’hlalo somsa. mahlan’ amanxeba, ahlatshw’ ekhalvari. ahlal’ ekhuleka, ayang’ khulumela. athi mxolele, mxolele; athi mxolele, mxolele; angafi ophendukayo. uyis’umzw’ encenga ogcotshiwe wakhe. angefulathele indodana yakhe. nomoya uyamuzwela; nomoya uyamuzwela; uthi, ngizelwe yinkosi.

hymns.searchText: shay’ insimbi namuhla injabulo 247 shay’ insimbi! namhla injabulo. ngomuntu obuy’ enkangala, nang’ uyis’ emhlangabeza ngendlela, was’ emanga, okhatheleyo. ngcwele! ngcwele! kush’ iz’ngelosi: ngcwele! ngcwele! kusho ugubhu. yimpi enjengo lwandle lugubhuza, lwandis ingoma eligugu. shay’ insimbi! namhla yinjabulo. ngoba umzuli ubuyile; inhliziyo ison’ isishiyile, ingumntwana ozelweyo. ngcwele! ngcwele! kush’ iz’ngelosi: ngcwele! ngcwele! kusho ugubhu. yimpi enjengo lwandle lugubhuza, lwandis ingoma eligugu. shay’ insimbi! mema idili namhla ngokunqoba ziyacul’ iz’ingelosi; xox’ indab’ emnandi njenge zinyosi ngob’ umuntu uzelwe busha. ngcwele! ngcwele! kush’ iz’ngelosi: ngcwele! ngcwele! kusho ugubhu. yimpi enjengo lwandle lugubhuza, lwandis ingoma eligugu.

hymns.searchText: zazi ngamashum’ alithoba nethoba 249 zazi ngamashum’ ayithoba nethob’ esibayeni kodw’ enye isemagqumeni ngapandle kwesibaya kuse phakathi kwezintaba yayehlukene nomalusi yayehlukene nomalusi nkosi, unamashumi angaka awanele yini? e, waphendula umalusi: "yedukil’ enye imvu; noma indlela inameva ngizoyifuna imvu yami ngizoyifuna imvu yami" kakho kubahlengwa owaqonda kunzima kangaka! laph’ inkosi yedlula khona ingaka tholi imvu phel’ imvu yayigula ifa phel’ imvu yayigula ifa nkosi, ophelan’ amathons’ egazi enyus’ intaba? ophela lowo owaduka yen’ engaka buyiswa ngani izandla zalinyazwa? zalinyazelw’ izono zethu zalinyazelw’ izono zethu zonk’ intaba zaquma ngento kwath’ ekuphakameni kwenyuk’ izwi laya ezulwini lathi, "bongani imvu selitholakele igugu bongan’ inkosi ngento yayo!"

hymns.searchText: balekel’ is’lingo 250 balekel’ isilingo, unyamalale; kunqoba kosiza uzuz’ omunye. zam’ uye phambili, yeka ulunya. hlal’ ubhek’ ujesu, woku phephisa! hlala ucel’ ujesu, akugcine ngamandla. yen’ uyelekelela; woku phephisa. shiy’ ukonakala, lahl’ ukwethuka; ungaphaphi ngeze kukajehova. cabang’ ukhuthale, yiba nomusa. hlal’ ubhek’ ujesu, wokuphephisa! hlala ucel’ ujesu, akugcine ngamandla. yen’ uyelekelela; woku phephisa. yena onqobile, uzakuvuzwa sonqoba ngenkolo, noma sisawa umsindisi wethu wosiph’ amandla, hlal’ ubhek’ ujesu, wokuphephisa! hlala ucel’ ujesu, akugcine ngamandla. yen’ uyelekelela; woku phephisa.
hymns.title: Balekel’ Is’lingo

hymns.searchText: soze ngasindiswa ngokukhala 251 soze ngasindiswa, ngokukhal’ iz’nyembezi kunge luqed’ uvalo, kungesuse isono ‘kukhal’ akusizi wangifela ujesu!, emthini wahlupheka ngase ngikhululeka, ng’sindiswe ngojesu! ngeke ngisindiswe nayi senzo esihle imicabang’ emihle, phinde ingenze musha umsebenzi yize wangifela ujesu!, emthini wahlupheka ngase ngikhululeka, ng’sindiswe ngojesu! khona ukulinda, akulutho, ngizofa ngiw’ umsa endlebeni, mangilinda, ngizofa ngoba akusizi wangifela ujesu!, emthini wahlupheka ngase ngikhululeka, ng’sindiswe ngojesu! ngenkolo kukrestu ngizosindiswa kuye ngithemb’ isenzo sakhe, mangiy’ ezingalweni; ngisinde ngenkolo wangifela ujesu!, emthini wahlupheka ngase ngikhululeka, ng’sindiswe ngojesu!
hymns.title: Soze Ngasindiswa Ngokukhala

hymns.searchText: woza moni onezono 252 woza moni onezono inkosi inesisa ngempela yokuphumuza nxa ushi’ izono themb’ ujesu, themb’ ujesu, ubomthemba nje! wosindiswa, wosindiswa khona, namhlanje! ujesu wachith’ igazi ‘waletha iz’busiso manje cwila kuzamcolo uhlanzwe yigazi themb’ ujesu, themb’ ujesu, ubomthemba nje! wosindiswa, wosindiswa khona, namhlanje! nguy’ ujesu oyindlela ey’ ekuphumleni uyokukhiph’ ebubini uma umlandela themb’ ujesu, themb’ ujesu, ubomthemba nje! wosindiswa, wosindiswa khona, namhlanje! woza kwes’mhlop’ isixulu uy’ ebungcweleni uhlal’ ekujabuleni zonke izinsuku themb’ ujesu, themb’ ujesu, ubomthemba nje! wosindiswa, wosindiswa khona, namhlanje!
hymns.title: Woza Moni Onezono

hymns.searchText: nangu umalusi umile 253 nang’ umalusi umile ethathekisile uyamemeza izimvu az’ gone zonke-du! uth’ azize kuye manje kafuni zesabe lok’ ibusisa ezinje inkosi yez’ngcwele s’bek’ izimvu kuz’ izandla nkosi unamandla loku nathi singabakho nans’ inzalo yakho

hymns.searchText: dumis’ ujehova 254 dumis’ ujehova khon’ emagumbini vuk’ ubonge! nas’ emukhathini zez’ uthando lwakhe; nesis’ esikhona ngokwenziwe beth’ impalampala, kwandiswe ngeqolo ngangodumo! makulethw’ imtshingo kuhutshw’ injabulo, phakamis’ iphimbo ngak’ okwakhe lapho ubabaza thint’ intambo lezi kube mnandi! yen’ uyashisiya wonke angaphezi, esh’ ub’khulu bakhe emdumisa

hymns.searchText: ngikudingile, jesu 255 ngikudingile jesu loku ngingo mpofu nging’ umuntu’ ozulayo angi nay’ imfuyo ngidinga wena jesu ngibambe umgudu welus’ inyawo zami nayo inhliziyo ngidinga yen’ ujesu njalo anginake ngize ngilwe nes’lingo engelekelela ngiding’ umoy’ ongcwele nami ngibe naye ngifundiswe ngojesu onge yam’ indlela o jesu, oligugu! ngoza nini kuwe ngihlotshiswe ngobuhle ngibe nobukhosi kuthi naba sindiswa njalo ngeneliswe ngicule ngingaphezi ngibusa nenkosi, amen!

hymns.searchText: o, jehova waphakade 256 o, jehova waphakade! themba elimile kuko konke nqaba yethu ulikhaya lethu phansi kwesihlalo sakho kukhon’ is’phephelo kothokoza izingcwele nathi sivikelwe zingaka dalwa izintaba ungekho nomhlaba phakade ung’ unkulunkulu wena wedw’ umkhulu inkulungwane zem’nyaka kuwe liny’ ilanga zona z’phelela ezeni wen’ ukhona nini
